Subject: Sprint Synapse: QBR prep & exec follow-ups

All —

Thanks for a focused sync this morning. I captured the high-level exec asks we need to close before the QBR and a handful of follow-ups from the product/infra side. Please see the attached action matrix (synapse-action-matrix.csv) and the Confluence page (link below) for the current state. Key asks below — can each owner comment with an in-line confidence level (green/amber/red) and a target date by EOD Jan 14?

1) Canary gating criteria for new routing fallback (exec ask): define SLO gates, rollback conditions, and telemetry checklist. Owner: Marissa.
2) Dedicated reservation delta estimate for PilotRetail pilot (finance & infra ask): confirm additional GPU-hours for reserved capacity vs expected burst. Owner: Ben.
3) Runbook + fallback play for regional outage (reliability): produce a 1-page runbook and the play deck for execs. Owner: Vivek.
4) Risk summary and prioritized mitigations for QBR slide deck. Owner: Jonas.

Attachments: synapse-action-matrix.csv. Related links: https://confluence.redwood.com/display/PLAT/Sprint+Synapse+QBR+prep

Next xfn touchpoint is Monday 1/11 at 10am PT — this thread will be the single source of updates; please avoid creating parallel threads.

Thanks,
Naomi

Marissa / Naomi —

Quick update and a few clarifying Qs. I'm attaching a short capacity analysis (capacity-analysis-1229.pdf) and an appendix (capacity-delta-appendix.xlsx) to the matrix.

Summary: PilotRetail is running a hybrid pattern (sustained baseline with predictable weekly peaks). My preliminary delta estimate for Dedicated reservations is +38 GPU-hours/day during pilot peak windows; that's without caching/tuning applied. Confidence: amber -> moving to green after tuning iteration.

Questions:
- Which SLA baseline should we use for canary gating? Is it 95th pct latency last 30 days or the pre-pilot baseline (Nov median)? I need exec direction.
- Alex (cc'd) — can your team share production token distribution for the pilot (approx requests/hour) — that will let me tighten the delta.

Attachments: capacity-analysis-1229.pdf, capacity-delta-appendix.xlsx

Thanks,
Ben

Subject: Re: Sprint Synapse: QBR prep & exec follow-ups

Naomi —

I sketched the runbook and attached a draft (runbook-draft.md). Plan is:
- 1-page play for execs + 3 runbook steps for SREs (detect, failover, communicate).
- Tabletop scheduled Thu 1/13 11am PT (I'll run).
- Dependencies: need the canary gating thresholds (Marissa) and capacity delta final (Ben) to validate rollback timings.

On the regional outage fallback: my recommended immediate fallback is to switch routing to the lowest-cost compatible model in the same region (Model-X-quant) and enable KV-cache warm start — that keeps latency within acceptable slabs and reduces GPU pressure.

Doc link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2bSynapsePlaybook

—Vivek

Team —

Great progress, thank you. Quick readout and next steps:

- Marissa: gating doc due 1/12 COB (if amber persists, call out exact missing signals).
- Ben: finalize capacity delta and confirm SLA baseline — please pick Nov median baseline unless you explicitly call otherwise; update matrix by 1/13 EOD.
- Vivek: runbook draft looks reasonable; run the tabletop 1/13 and push final 1-pager by 1/14.
- Jonas: risk slides due 1/14 EOD.

Alex / PilotRetail: thanks for staying looped; any data Alex can share this week would materially reduce uncertainty.

I'm marking this thread as the canonical QBR prep thread. If owners hit blockers, escalate here and I'll triage. Final ask: everyone reply with a single-line status update by EOD 1/14 (green/amber/red + date).

Thanks,
